chapter_name: What is Long? What is Round?
learning_objective: 🎯 We will look at fun things around us to see if they are long like a pencil or round like a ball!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Some things are straight and tall. A pencil, a cricket bat, and a ruler are long things!
Some things have no corners and look like a circle. A ball, an orange, and a coin are round things!
Round things can roll super fast! Things with flat sides slide on the floor like a book.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Roll and Slide Test!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a small ball and a notebook. Try pushing them gently on the floor to see which one rolls and which one slides!

quick_recap: ⭐ Long things are straight, like a stick.
⭐ Round things have no corners, like a yummy laddoo.
⭐ Round things roll, and flat things slide!
